info.name: Amazon Serverless Application Repository API
info.description:
The AWS Serverless Application Repository enables teams, organizations, and individual developers to find, deploy, and publish serverless applications. It provides programmatic access to create, manage, and deploy SAM-based serverless applications and manage their versions and policies.

Contact Support:
 Name: Amazon Web Services
